values.note: $30 single site, $59 double site. One vehicle included; $8 per extra vehicle per night. Same in the 2027 rate table.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/chambers-lake-campground ('Single Site: $30 per night', 'Double Site: $59 per night'; last updated September 21, 2026) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/231853/rates (2026 and 2027 Peak: STANDARD NONELECTRIC 30, double 59) + /campgrounds/231853 (EXTRA VEHICLE FEES notice: '$8.00 per vehicle per night'), read 2026-10-26

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/231853 (notice 'RV electric, sewer and water connections are not available') + campsite catalog for 231853 (all NONELECTRIC), read 2026-10-26

values.note: 43 single and double family sites for RVs, trailers and tents (37 reservable, 6 first-come) and 7 tent-only sites; all back-in. The catalog's max vehicle lengths run 21-38 ft (most 30); the Forest Service gives parking spurs of 20 to 45 feet, and RVs must fit on the spur.

sites.source: recreation.gov campsite catalog for 231853 (site types, reservable flag, Max Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry; management site excluded) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/chambers-lake-campground ('RVs, trailers or other vehicles must fit on the parking spur ... The parking length ranges from 20 to 45 feet.'), read 2026-10-26

values.note: Drinking water hydrants, but arrive with the RV tank filled: filling RV tanks at the hydrants is not allowed. Playground.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/chambers-lake-campground ('Restrooms: Vault toilet(s)'; 'Potable water is available at this site'; 'A playground is available') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/231853 ('Come with your RV/trailer water tank filled. Filling at campground hydrants cross-contaminates the system and is not allowed.'), read 2026-10-26

values.note: Reservable on recreation.gov for the 2026 season June 12 - Sept 19; 'Sites may be available on a first-come, first-served basis outside the reservation season', and 9 sites are first-come. Booking closes 4 days before arrival; no minimum stay listed. A reserved site not occupied within 26 hours goes first-come.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/231853 (facility_rules reservationCutOff 4 'day(s) prior to arrival', no stay rules; notices quoted) + /rates (2026 Peak Season 06-12 to 09-19) + campsite catalog (9 non-reservable family sites), read 2026-10-26

note: Upper Poudre, about 51 miles up CO-14 from US-287 and a mile past the Laramie River Road (Canyon Lakes RD, Arapaho-Roosevelt NF), 9,200 ft beside Chambers Lake; fishing, canoeing and trails, no-wake boating on the lake. No extra parking. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $30 (2026-27), 50 sites, 38-ft max (catalog; FS spurs 20-45 ft), no hookups, reservable on recreation.gov. Added reservable season 06-12 to 09-19, some sites FCFS, 4-day cutoff, vault toilets, water (no RV tank filling), pull_through false. No campground season stated (left absent). No alert closes CO-14 or the campground (Cameron Peak and Salt Cabin closures are elsewhere on the district).
flags: Waterfront re-audit lead: recreation.gov says the campground is 'located ... on beautiful Chambers Lake'; the entry is 'lakeview'. Not changed.
Entry has no phone. recreation.gov gives 970-295-6700 (Canyon Lakes Ranger District) and (530) 529-0578 'for facility specific information' (concessionaire, not named); the FS page gives no number.
Agency page for the website if wanted: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/chambers-lake-campground (website is the recreation.gov listing).
